# S82 — Waves screen: suggested list, tick items, overlap warnings, launch a wave

The Waves view for one project. It lists the suggested waves, lets the owner tick items, shows each ticked item's lineup and any shared paths, and launches the ticked items as one wave after a y/n confirm. Nothing is written before the confirm.

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

docs/dashboard.md:183-195 draws the wave composer: the plan-parallel list with ticks, a Lineup column, an overlap warning line, and `[l] launch wave`. Decision 17 (wave.selection): suggested by slicer, edited by the owner, with overlap warnings. Decision 18 (wave.scope): one project per wave. Decision 98 (ui.confirm): launch confirms, Enter is No. Decision 121 (ui.view-list): Waves is the third view and S58 skips it until its built flag is set. docs/design.md:154: the owner approves the wave as checkpoint 1, so one confirm covers the wave.

## Failing tests

- TestWavesListsSuggestedWaves: rows follow WaveSuggest in wave order; unplaced items show with their reason (for example no_files).
- TestWavesSuggestErrorVerbatim: a failed WaveSuggest shows its code and message verbatim and keeps the screen.
- TestWavesTickAsksInputsThenPlans: ticking an item asks well-specified and split (records 86, 87: y/n, no default) before any Plan call; the Lineup column then shows the plan's lineup.
- TestWavesOverlapWarning: two ticked items that share a path show "! A and B both touch PATH"; the warning does not block launch (record 17 says warn).
- TestWavesLaunchConfirmsOnce: the launch key shows one confirm with the exact command; Enter, n and esc start nothing; y calls WaveStart once with the ticked items, their inputs and their plans as Expected.
- TestWavesWritesNothingBeforeConfirm: no write method on the Live fake is called before y.
- TestWavesErrorVerbatim: a failed WaveStart shows its code and message verbatim.
- TestTabReachesTheWavesView: with Waves built, tab from Overview reaches Waves in the record 121 order.
- Golden views, colour and monochrome.

## Implement

1. Blocked until S58, S52, S60 and S81 land. Write waves_test.go first from the Failing-tests above, with a fake Live. Run them and confirm they fail.
2. live.go, daemon.go, client.go: add WaveSuggest, WaveOverlap and WaveStart; update the fakes.
3. waves.go: load WaveSuggest when the view opens or the project changes. Draw the waves, unplaced items and errors.
4. Tick: toggle an item; ask the two y/n inputs (textField, internal/tui/field.go:12) and call Plan as S52 does. Store the plan per item.
5. After each tick change with two or more ticked items, call WaveOverlap and draw one warning line per shared pair.
6. Launch: show the confirm bar with `ork wave start P ID...`; y calls WaveStart with each item's inputs and plan as Expected. Enter is No (model.go:302-304).
7. Errors go through actionError (model.go:617) without rewording.
8. view.go: set the Waves built flag; draw the body.
9. Run go test ./internal/tui -update and review testdata/golden/waves-*.txt.
10. Update docs/dashboard.md (:183-195).

Decided 2026-10-20: record 135 (`ui.wave-composer`): space ticks a row and asks the two y/n inputs at once, then plans it; l launches with one confirm. The running-wave part of the screen (dashboard.md:197-217) is not in this slice; S55 covers the run tree. Editing the lineup is S83.
